name: Filigree Von Curlicue
description: Mirrored scrollwork, lace and wrought iron. Nothing here is plain, and nothing has ever been plain.

designs.title: Damask Medallion
designs.description: Heart-shaped scrolls stacked inside a double-lined medallion. Symmetrical work for the sternum.

designs.title: Lace Collar
designs.description: A necklace of lace with spoked rosettes and a single pendant, drawn to follow the collarbone.

designs.title: Empty Cartouche
designs.description: A baroque frame of curling scrolls, left empty on purpose. What goes inside is your problem.

designs.title: Chandelier Drop
designs.description: A ballroom chandelier with six candles and a beaded swag. Hangs well from the sternum down.

designs.title: Wrought Gate
designs.description: An arched iron gate full of paired scrolls under a crown of leaves. Good on the forearm.

designs.title: Spade Finial
designs.description: A tall spade outline filled with scrollwork, like the top of an old garden railing.
